in_marathi.name: Chethana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Consciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chethana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chethana is a Sanskrit name that originates from the Hindu tradition. It is derived from the word 'chid-rupa' which means 'consciousness'. The name symbolizes the divine feminine energy that embodies awareness and self-realization. Chethana is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, who represents knowledge, creativity, and wisdom.
